How to use Etali

For tailors, hairdressers, mechanics, farmers, caterers, shopkeepers, technicians and every trade that sells skills or products, in Cameroon, elsewhere in Africa or in the diaspora, and for those who do not yet know what to sell.

Open Etali ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to etali.vercel.app and choose French or English.

2

Tap Find what I can sell for a four-minute conversation, or pick your trade to build your page at once.

3

Or open Guided demos and walk through one of 20 trades as its owner, on fictional data.

4

Publish two or three offers with a price or the words on quote, and share the link or QR code.

5

Pay for a plan only when it helps you earn: by WhatsApp, Mobile Money or in kind.

02

Features

01

Storefront

A public page at /@name with offers, prices from or on quote, opening hours, languages, reviews from paying customers only and a request button; readable without installing anything.

STEPS

  1. Add offers from Sell
  2. Share the link, WhatsApp button or QR code
  3. Set hours, languages and service area in Settings
02

Today and the inbox

Three actions for the day, then one inbox for form requests, pasted WhatsApp messages and noted calls, each with a draft reply from Kola that you edit and send yourself.

STEPS

  1. Open Manage, then Today
  2. Paste a WhatsApp message into the inbox
  3. Reply, then turn the request into a quote
03

Quotes and invoices

Line items split into labour, materials and other, a deposit percentage, validity and terms; invoices with partial payments, polite reminders and printable receipts.

STEPS

  1. Create a quote or let Kola draft one from a request
  2. Check the flagged assumptions
  3. Accept, then create the invoice in one tap
04

Money and the simulator

Invoiced, collected, spent and the cash result kept apart, six months of history, expenses by category and CSV export; a simulator that replays six months for a price change, a hire, equipment on credit, advertising or delivery.

STEPS

  1. Note each expense in seconds
  2. Read the cash result each week
  3. Test a decision before spending
05

Kola

A cofounder that reads your own records with your permission and prepares replies, quotes, campaigns and reports; everything waits in Validations until you approve it.

STEPS

  1. Choose a mode: discovery, sales, finance, operations
  2. Ask a question about your numbers
  3. Approve or discard each draft
06

Guided demos

Twenty common trades, from tailoring and hair to solar, moto delivery and export crafts. Each demo signs you in as a fictional owner and walks eleven screens with a highlight and an explanation.

STEPS

  1. Open Guided demos and pick a trade
  2. Press Start the guided demo
  3. Use Next, or explore freely and come back
07

Books and academy

Two books read in the app or downloaded as PDF: Entreprendre en Afrique, pour de vrai (313 pages) and Etali en action (185 pages, twenty trades with real screens), plus a 25-volume academy whose lessons end with an action.

STEPS

  1. Open Books from the menu
  2. Read chapter by chapter, online or offline once opened
  3. Download the PDF to print or share
08

Prices and payment

Plans paid by the week, month or year with a person on WhatsApp, by MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money, or in kind with work or products; the page composes the WhatsApp message and nothing is debited automatically.

STEPS

  1. Choose a plan and a period
  2. Choose how to pay, including in kind
  3. Send the message; a person replies to finalise
03Tips
  • Write the price before doing the work: most disputes start with an oral agreement.
  • Ask for a deposit before buying materials, every time.
  • A customer who comes back each month is worth more than a big job once.
04FAQ
Is Etali free?

Yes, the free plan has no time limit: storefront, requests, quotes, invoices, introductory lessons and both books.

Does Etali hold my money?

No. Payments go through licensed providers; in the demonstration they are simulated.

Does Kola send messages for me?

No. Kola prepares drafts; you approve and send them.

Does it work on a basic phone?

Yes. Pages are light, there is a low-data mode, and lessons and books stay readable offline once opened.
